_comment: Publications for publications.html. Regenerate from Google Scholar with tools/scholar_to_json.py (see README) or edit by hand. highlight_author: your name exactly as it appears in author lists (bolded). Each entry: title, authors (list), venue, year, type (conference | journal | workshop | preprint | thesis | other — drives the type filter), note (optional, e.g. 'Oral'), links (list of {label, url}).
